title: 電子郵件
description: 撰寫與回覆工作郵件的用語

sentences.en: I am writing to follow up on the proposal that was submitted last week and to inquire about the expected timeline for your review.
sentences.zh: 我寫信是為了跟進上週提交的提案，並詢問您預計的審查時程。

sentences.en: Please find attached the revised document, which incorporates all the changes that were discussed during our meeting on Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 請參閱附件中修訂後的文件，其中包含了我們週三會議中討論的所有修改。

sentences.en: I would appreciate it if you could confirm your availability for a brief call sometime this week to discuss the project requirements in detail.
sentences.zh: 如果您能確認本週某個時間是否方便簡短通話以詳細討論專案需求，我將不勝感激。

sentences.en: Due to unforeseen circumstances that arose this morning, I regret to inform you that we will need to reschedule our appointment originally set for tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 由於今天早上出現的意外狀況，很遺憾地通知您，我們需要重新安排原定明天的會面。

sentences.en: As per our earlier conversation regarding the budget allocation, I have prepared a detailed breakdown, which is included in the attached spreadsheet.
sentences.zh: 根據我們先前關於預算分配的對話，我已準備了詳細的明細，包含在附件的試算表中。

sentences.en: I wanted to bring to your attention an issue that was reported by several users, which appears to be related to the latest software update.
sentences.zh: 我想提請您注意一個多位使用者回報的問題，這似乎與最新的軟體更新有關。

sentences.en: Thank you for your prompt response to my inquiry; the information you provided will be extremely helpful in finalizing our strategic plan.
sentences.zh: 感謝您對我詢問的即時回覆；您提供的資訊對完成我們的策略計畫將非常有幫助。

sentences.en: Could you please forward this message to the relevant stakeholders who need to be informed about the changes to the delivery schedule?
sentences.zh: 能否請您將此訊息轉發給需要被告知交貨時程變更的相關利害關係人？

sentences.en: I am reaching out to request your approval for the travel expenses incurred during the client visit, the receipts for which are attached below.
sentences.zh: 我聯繫您是為了請求批准客戶拜訪期間產生的差旅費用，相關收據附在下方。

sentences.en: Following our discussion last Thursday, I have compiled a list of action items that require your review and approval before we can proceed.
sentences.zh: 根據我們上週四的討論，我整理了一份需要您審核和批准才能繼續進行的行動事項清單。

sentences.en: Please note that the deadline for submitting the quarterly performance reviews has been moved forward to the fifteenth of this month due to the upcoming audit.
sentences.zh: 請注意，由於即將進行的審計，提交季度績效評估的截止日期已提前至本月十五日。

sentences.en: I apologize for the delayed response; I was attending a conference abroad last week and had limited access to my email during that time.
sentences.zh: 抱歉回覆晚了；上週我在國外參加研討會，期間存取電子郵件的機會有限。

sentences.en: In reference to your email dated May twentieth, I would like to clarify that the pricing quoted includes all applicable taxes and shipping fees.
sentences.zh: 關於您五月二十日的電子郵件，我想澄清所報的價格已包含所有適用的稅費和運費。

sentences.en: We would be grateful if you could provide us with an updated status report on the deliverables that were due at the end of last month.
sentences.zh: 如果您能提供上月底到期的交付成果的最新狀態報告，我們將不勝感激。

sentences.en: I am copying the project coordinator on this email so that she can update the timeline and communicate any changes to the rest of the team.
sentences.zh: 我在這封郵件中副本給專案協調員，以便她更新時程表並將任何變更傳達給團隊其他成員。

sentences.en: Should you have any questions or require further clarification regarding the terms outlined in the attached contract, please do not hesitate to reach out.
sentences.zh: 如果您對附件合約中列出的條款有任何問題或需要進一步澄清，請隨時與我聯繫。

sentences.en: I wanted to let you know that the training session, which was originally planned for next Tuesday, has been postponed until a suitable venue can be secured.
sentences.zh: 我想讓您知道，原定下週二的培訓課程已被推遲，直到能確保合適的場地為止。

sentences.en: As discussed during our phone call this morning, I have updated the specifications document to reflect the client's most recent feedback and requirements.
sentences.zh: 如今天早上電話中所討論的，我已更新規格文件以反映客戶最新的回饋和需求。

sentences.en: This is a gentle reminder that the forms for the annual benefits enrollment, which were distributed last Monday, must be returned by the end of this week.
sentences.zh: 這是溫馨提醒：上週一發放的年度福利登記表格必須在本週結束前繳回。

sentences.en: I would like to schedule a meeting with you and your team to discuss the feasibility of implementing the proposed changes before the next fiscal quarter.
sentences.zh: 我想與您和您的團隊安排會議，討論在下一個會計季度之前實施所提議變更的可行性。

sentences.en: Please be advised that our office will be closed on Monday and Tuesday of next week due to the national holiday, and we will resume operations on Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 請注意，由於國定假日，我們辦公室下週一和週二將休息，週三恢復營運。

sentences.en: After careful consideration of the alternatives you presented, we have decided to proceed with the second option, which aligns more closely with our strategic objectives.
sentences.zh: 在仔細考慮了您提出的替代方案後，我們決定採用第二個方案，它與我們的策略目標更為一致。

sentences.en: I trust this email finds you well; I am writing to formally request an extension on the report deadline, as my team has encountered unexpected technical difficulties.
sentences.zh: 希望您一切順利；我寫信正式請求延長報告截止日期，因為我的團隊遇到了意外的技術困難。

sentences.en: For your reference, I have included a summary of the key decisions made during yesterday's board meeting, along with the relevant supporting documents.
sentences.zh: 供您參考，我附上了昨天董事會會議中所做的關鍵決策摘要，以及相關的佐證文件。

sentences.en: We regret to inform you that the shipment of materials, which was expected to arrive on Friday, has been delayed due to logistical issues at the distribution center.
sentences.zh: 我們遺憾地通知您，預計週五到達的材料出貨，因配送中心的物流問題而延遲。

sentences.en: I am pleased to confirm that your registration for the upcoming professional development workshop has been successfully processed and a confirmation number will follow shortly.
sentences.zh: 我很高興確認您對即將舉行的專業發展研討會的報名已成功處理，確認編號稍後會發送給您。

sentences.en: Kindly acknowledge receipt of this email at your earliest convenience so that I can proceed with the next steps outlined in the project timeline.
sentences.zh: 請您在方便時儘早確認收到此郵件，以便我按照專案時程表中列出的下一步驟進行。

sentences.en: With regard to the vendor dispute mentioned in your previous correspondence, our legal team has reviewed the contract and will provide their assessment by Thursday.
sentences.zh: 關於您先前通訊中提到的供應商爭議，我們的法務團隊已審閱合約，並將在週四前提供他們的評估。

sentences.en: I hope this message reaches you before the end of the business day, as I need your signature on the authorization form before the procurement process can begin.
sentences.zh: 我希望這封信在營業日結束前到達您手中，因為在採購流程開始之前我需要您在授權表上簽名。

sentences.en: Thank you for taking the time to provide such detailed feedback on the proposal; your suggestions have been incorporated into the revised version attached herewith.
sentences.zh: 感謝您花時間對提案提供如此詳細的回饋；您的建議已被納入隨信附上的修訂版本中。
